__NOTOC__
<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="amascut-the-devourer-2000" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Amascut, The Devourer 2000%</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/EFlnaJbrvr.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This is an early mechanics guide on 2000% Amascut. Beware of mistakes, and expect an update in the near future. Numbers may vary based on team size! If you have suggestions for our guides, post them </nowiki>[https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 <nowiki>here</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Amascut the Devourer is an endgame group boss encounter, available after completion of the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Eclipse_of_the_Heart <nowiki>Eclipse of the Heart</nowiki>]<nowiki> quest. Normal mode and 100%, 500%, 750%, 1000%, and 2000% enrage modes are available. Amascut drops the T95 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> halberd </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Tumeken%27s_Light <nowiki>Tumeken's Light</nowiki>]<nowiki>, the T95 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Devourer%27s_Guard <nowiki>Devourer's Guard</nowiki>]<nowiki>, the T95 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> robes of </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Tumeken%27s_resplendence_equipment <nowiki>Tumeken's Resplendence</nowiki>]<nowiki>, the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Devourer%27s_Nexus <nowiki>Devourer's Nexus</nowiki>]<nowiki>, and the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Shard_of_Genesis_Essence <nowiki>Shard of Genesis Essence</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="amascut-2000-stats"><nowiki>Amascut 2000% stats</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 12M </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Size: 3x3</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 95 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1" alt="defence" title="defence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 2765 armour rating</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 55 affinity all</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1" alt="poisonicon" title="poisonicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1" alt="stunicon" title="stunicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> immune</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Note: Most mobs are </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1" alt="poisonicon" title="poisonicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1" alt="stunicon" title="stunicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> immune!</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ No slayer creature</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="mechanics"><ins><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Auto-attacks:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Left hand </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> attack to all players.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Right hand </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> AoE attack on tank that ricochets as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> attacks on the other players. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ricochet has a 10-tile range.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Three rapid </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> swipes on the tank. The style depends on her last auto-attack: For example: if it was </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, the three hits will be </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The following autos are based on your protection or deflect prayer on the first swipe hit. If you prayed wrong against it, the following auto-attacks will be the same type as the swipe hit.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ After three autos, Amascut starts a new mechanic at 100% adrenaline.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mobs:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Gatekeeper Gorilla Akhs (150k LP). Need to be killed to use the gateways. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1" alt="stunicon" title="stunicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102897815073603685.png?v=1" alt="bindicon" title="bindicon" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Feline Guard Akhs (25k LP). Will target those carrying a fragment of Tumeken. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1" alt="stunicon" title="stunicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102897815073603685.png?v=1" alt="bindicon" title="bindicon" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Volatile Scarab Akhs (2k LP).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They need to be stunned </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1" alt="stunicon" title="stunicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to take damage, and will explode if left alone.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Their spawn can be prevented by standing within one tile of their burrowing spots.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Doing this successfully resets mobility cooldowns.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Modest Crocodile Demons (50k LP).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When its adrenaline bar is full, does </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> attack removing 20% adrenaline and applying a -50% adrenaline gain debuff on the target.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Have Modesty buff.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Chainwarden Mage Akhs (130k LP). Protects the chains (50k LP each) beyond the gateways.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Explosive Scarabs (5k LP). Can be killed and then thrown to remove Carapace. Expire over time when killed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Lightstealer Salawa Akh (50k LP). Will target Tumeken's light bearers and drain charge or explode. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1" alt="stunicon" title="stunicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102897815073603685.png?v=1" alt="bindicon" title="bindicon" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Devoured Mage and Ranger (15k LP). Stand on the platforms, barring you from Tumeken's Light.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Shadow of Amascut (150k LP). Deal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1" alt="stunicon" title="stunicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102897815073603685.png?v=1" alt="bindicon" title="bindicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Can reduce </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> timer.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="buffs-and-debuffs"><nowiki>Buffs and Debuffs</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Lone Soul</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1403076345084379337.png?v=1" alt="shadowlink" title="shadowlink" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Heal Other </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1" alt="healother" title="healother" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Heal Group </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1404462300722626642.png?v=1" alt="healgroup" title="healgroup" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and Intercept </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1" alt="cept" title="cept" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are disabled at 2000% and above.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Same icon as Shadow Link.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Corruption</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402610315480535050.png?v=1" alt="corruption" title="corruption" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The base gains one stack of Corruption </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402610315480535050.png?v=1" alt="corruption" title="corruption" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for every auto-attack received, increasing damage taken. Getting hit by Soulfire waves and Shockwaves also gives </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402610315480535050.png?v=1" alt="corruption" title="corruption" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stacks. Max 15 stacks, and stacks expire ~15s after the last one has been given.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In phase 7 every player gets </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402610315480535050.png?v=1" alt="corruption" title="corruption" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stacks from Amascut's auto-attacks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Apmeken's Burden</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402579857648390224.png?v=1" alt="apmekensburden" title="apmekensburden" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Is applied by Amascut early in phase 2. Deals damage every 1.8s and adds a stack. Can be transferred to teammates. Damage increases every hit, instakilling the player at 8 stacks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage can be halved by </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (not by </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Amascut will apply this debuff in phase 7 when Apmeken is invoked.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Modesty</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402583151322071091.png?v=1" alt="modesty" title="modesty" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Reflects non-basic attacks such as threshold and ultimate abilities, adren-costing </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> abilities, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> , </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1" alt="volleyofsouls" title="volleyofsouls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> , plus extra hits from </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1" alt="bolg" title="bolg" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1" alt="fsoa" title="fsoa" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Does </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> reflect basic abilities, auto-attacks, conjure damage, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712074245202772009.png?v=1" alt="as4" title="as4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> , </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087662686249.png?v=1" alt="crack4" title="crack4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> , and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1" alt="poisonicon" title="poisonicon" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Healing in Strength</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585055297273896.png?v=1" alt="healinginstrength" title="healinginstrength" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Mobs can have this effect during Phase 4, where any damage they deal heals Amascut for ~30%.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Amascut gains this effect in phase 7 when Het is invoked.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Carapace</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585081624924210.png?v=1" alt="carapace" title="carapace" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Multiple mobs can have this effect during Phase 4, where they are immune to damage until an explosive scarab is thrown at them.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Amascut gains this effect in phase 7 when Scabaras is invoked. Requires 3 Scarabs to break.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Interceptor</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1" alt="interceptor" title="interceptor" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Gained upon blocking Amascut's Altar strike once in phase 5. Taking another strike will be an instakill </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1" alt="instakill" title="instakill" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Enlightened</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1" alt="interceptor" title="interceptor" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Gained after Jumping and taken Tumeken's Light in phase 6. Appears as a 5x5 light area around you.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Any green bar blasts exploding in the area are nulled.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Same icon as Interceptor.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Shadow Tear</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833098100745.png?v=1" alt="comb" title="comb" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Debuff from absorbing Engulfed Shadow Tears in phase 6. Explode after a short period of time, Dealing </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage for each tear absorbed. Says it pierces through shielding, but </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> blocks it fully.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Same icon as combust.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Shadow Link</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1403076345084379337.png?v=1" alt="shadowlink" title="shadowlink" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Shadows of Amascut have a buff when within 15 squares of each other called Shadow Link. This increases their attack speed and damage dealt per stack, and they can hit through </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Inner Darkness</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1403076345084379337.png?v=1" alt="shadowlink" title="shadowlink" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut will take reduced damage from all sources that do not have the Light Within buff in phase 7.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Same icon as Shadow Link.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Light Within</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1" alt="interceptor" title="interceptor" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Granted to all players when successfully passing Tumeken's Strike to the called altar in phase 7, ricocheting it back to Amascut. Allows them to deal full damage to Amascut for 30s.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Same icon as Interceptor.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-1-12000k"><nowiki>Phase 1 (12000k)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ 3 autos → Triple Tap → swipes → 2 autos → Summon Scarabs → 1 auto → swipes → 1 auto → Crushing Soul → 2 autos → swipes → Empowered Eruption → 3 autos → Triple Tap → swipes → 2 autos → phase 2</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Triple Tap</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut says </nowiki><code><nowiki>Grovel</nowiki></code><nowiki>, </nowiki><code><nowiki>pathetic</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎or </nowiki><code><nowiki>weak</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and will launch three projectiles in the air, with each colour corresponding to a combat style (green: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, blue: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, red: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) on the tank. These will hit the tank two ticks apart.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code><nowiki>Grovel</nowiki></code><nowiki>: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code><nowiki>Pathetic</nowiki></code><nowiki>: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code><nowiki>Weak</nowiki></code><nowiki>: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Summon Scarabs</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut says </nowiki><code><nowiki>Tear them apart</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and summons Volatile Scarab Akhs. They need to be stunned </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1" alt="stunicon" title="stunicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to take damage. Will explode if left alone, dealing typeless damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage can be blocked by </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and spawn prevented by being near their burrow location.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Crushing Soul</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut says </nowiki><code><nowiki>Bend the knee</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and deals big typeless damage on the tank. Has defensive penetration. Damage can be shared with nearby teammates in a 3x3 around the base..</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• At 2000% to survive this solo, use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1" alt="immort" title="immort" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Teams can have the DPS pile </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1" alt="voke" title="voke" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to share this damage (with a defensive), then have base </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1" alt="voke" title="voke" kind="icon" /><nowiki> back.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Empowered Eruption</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut says </nowiki><code><nowiki>I will not suffer this.</nowiki></code><nowiki>, </nowiki><code><nowiki>Your soul is weak</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎, or , </nowiki><code><nowiki>All strength withers</nowiki></code><nowiki>, or and the arena turns a certain colour, corresponding to a combat style (green: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, blue: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, red: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>). Every player will take three hits from that style. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is recommended.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code><nowiki>Your soul is weak</nowiki></code><nowiki>: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code><nowiki>All strength withers</nowiki></code><nowiki>: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code><nowiki>I will not suffer this</nowiki></code><nowiki>: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Empowered auto</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ When Amascut does her three rapid </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> auto-attacks, Amascut deals another </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> hit to the tank, same tick as the third attack. This auto will always be a different style from the original three.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Tank pull</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Whenever the person with aggro is too far from Amascut, she will say </nowiki><code><nowiki>You dare to turn your back on me?</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and drag them before her. This stuns </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1" alt="stunicon" title="stunicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and binds </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102897815073603685.png?v=1" alt="bindicon" title="bindicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> you for 3s. Gives adrenaline to Amascut, likely replaces an auto-attack.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut's health caps at 9000k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-2"><nowiki>Phase 2</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Devourer's Destruction</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Amascut says </nowiki><code><nowiki>ENOUGH! Bring forth Crondis and Apmeken</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and a destruction timer of 100.2s starts. When the timer ends, every player is instakilled.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Two Gatekeeper gorilla akhs on the sides. They can stun and be stunned/bound. One random player gets marked with Apmeken's Burden </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402579857648390224.png?v=1" alt="apmekensburden" title="apmekensburden" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. This debuff is a ramping bleed and can be passed to others by standing next to them, resetting the damage. Modest Crocodile Demons spawn at both northern entrances, deal heavy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage, and reflect non-basic ability damage. When their adrenaline bar is full, the target's adrenaline gain is reduced by 50%. Feline Guard Akhs and Lightstealer Salawa Akhs spawn as time progresses.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ After the Gatekeeper Gorilla Akhs are dead, players can go into gateways west and east to free the Echoes of Apmeken and Crondis. Within they will find a Chainwarden Akh and three chains.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Every killed chain turns the respective statue yellow instead of green. A player in the main arena cleanses the corrupted statue every time, permanently killing the chain. Clicking the statue early deals damage. Chains respawn over time if the statue is not cleansed within ~12s.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Chains can be </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1156683164593430579.png?v=1" alt="soulstrikeflank" title="soulstrikeflank" kind="icon" /><nowiki> from the west/east/north especially in the eastern gateways. This is favourable for necro users.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ After all three chains are broken and cleansed, the player inside the respective room can liberate the god and receive their fragment of Tumeken (30s buff timer).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After Crondis' blessing, two more Modest Crocodile Demons spawn.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Bringing the blessing to the right statue will stun Amascut for 25s. You cannot use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> during this, but </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109431029761.png?v=1" alt="prismofsalvation" title="prismofsalvation" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1" alt="barge" title="barge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> do work. The stuns of both blessings stack, and after they end phase 3 starts.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Lightstealer Salawa Akhs spawn from the south in group of three. They can charge a blue bar and barge on players, prioritising those carrying Tumeken's light. This hits 6-7k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage per akh.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These should be prioritised to kill.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Empowered Soulfire</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ During phase 2 the main arena has waves of Empowered Soulfire passing over it, south to north. Along the Chains, Empowered Soulfire will also appear. These deal magic damage. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> blocks damage, but duration is reduced by 3s for each hit. Each hit taken gives one </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402610315480535050.png?v=1" alt="corruption" title="corruption" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stack.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut's health caps at 7200k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-3-ugh-no"><nowiki>Phase 3 (</nowiki><code><nowiki>Ugh... No!</nowiki></code><nowiki>)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Similar to phase 1, but includes Devourer's Shockwave with every mechanic.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Rotation:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>33% adren no auto → swipes → auto → Triple Tap → 2 autos → swipes → Summon Scarabs → 3x same auto → Crushing Soul → swipes → 2 autos → Empowered Eruption → auto → swipes → auto → Triple Tap → 2 autos → swipes → phase 4.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Devourer's Shockwave</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Amascut concentric shockwaves spread from under her outward.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The pattern is always the same:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• First only a &quot;middle&quot; ring of 3 tiles wide. MD is safe, far range is safe.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Second are three consecutive shockwaves moving from inner to outer.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Inner (9x9 including under Amascut)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Middle (ring of 3 tiles wide)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Outer (ring of 6 tiles wide).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Deals typeless damage, resets defensives, and puts them on a 6s cooldown. When hit, adds 1 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402610315480535050.png?v=1" alt="corruption" title="corruption" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stack.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut's health caps at 4800k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-4"><nowiki>Phase 4</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Devourer's Destruction</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Amascut says </nowiki><code><nowiki>Scabaras...Het... Bear witness!</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and the destruction timer starts again similar to phase 2.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Players can go into gateways west and east to free the Echoes of Het and Scabaras after killing the Gatekeeper gorilla akhs. No modest crocodiles spawn.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Scarab bombs</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Explosive Scarab Akhs spawn in the arena.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Scarabs will not spawn on players in a 3x3 area (can use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to stop spawns).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Every non-scarab mob NPC has a carapace that makes them immune to damage. Remove the carapace by killing and grabbing Explosive Scarab Akhs, then throwing Scarabs to the NPC and through the gateways. Weaken and kill the Gatekeeper Gorilla Akhs. You need 4 Scarabs per gateway for the Chainwarden Akh and the three chains. Scarab throwing has unlimited attack range but does require line-of-sight. Alive Explosive Scarab Akhs heal Amascut over time (100 LP/Scarab/1.2s). Dead Scarabs explode over time and deal minor typeless damage to all players in the arena.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut's health caps at 3000k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-5-tumekens-reformation"><nowiki>Phase 5 Tumeken's Reformation</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Charging the fragment of Tumeken</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut says </nowiki><code><nowiki>Tumeken's heart. Delivered to me by these mortals</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and four fragments shoot out of each statue, and Tumeken appears in the middle.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Two Soul Obelisks appear west and east with 30k out of 50k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and at full health they will deal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage to all players in their half of the arena.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Keep their health below 50k. Soul obelisks stop healing when taking damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Channel statue energy to the fragments by having one or multiple players link energy from the statue to the fragment.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Altar Strike</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut will say </nowiki><code><nowiki>your light will be snuffed out, once and for all</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎strike the fragments via the altars/statues, draining them of charge.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Interception</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Have a player stand on the green line to intercept Amascut's attack. All lines can be blocked simultaneously by standing in front of Amascut. Taking two hits in a row is an instakill (Interceptor debuff), so switch out with your teammates. Lightstealer Salawa Akhs will continuously spawn from the southern stairs and drain charge from the fragments of Tumeken if reached.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Blinking Strike</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ After a fragment is fully charged, Reform Tumeken in the centre and Amascut will become attackable again. She will start dashing and attacking the Reformed Tumeken four times saying </nowiki><code><nowiki>GET OUT OF MY WAY!</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki><code><nowiki>I AM.</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎</nowiki><code><nowiki>THE GOD.</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎</nowiki><code><nowiki>OF.</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎</nowiki><code><nowiki>DESTRUCTION</nowiki></code><nowiki>. If not intercepted by the player called by Tumeken </nowiki><code><nowiki>(name) shield us from her shadow…</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎the attack will instakill the party. The intercept damage has 10% </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1" alt="defence" title="defence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> penetration and can ricochets to other nearby players, sharing the damage. After the four attacks, more fragments have to be charged if progress has not reached 100.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The called player should stand closest to Amascut's </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Southwest tile</nowiki></ins><nowiki>, others should keep their distance.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ For every fragment charged, reform progress increases by 1 every 1.2s. If any Lightstealer Salawa Akh explodes near Tumeken this will instakill the party.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Killing the Lightstealer Salawa Akhs has high priority in this phase. Can use binds </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102897815073603685.png?v=1" alt="bindicon" title="bindicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to prevent them from getting too close to Tumeken (within its 5x5 area).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut transitions to phase 6 at 100% reform progress.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut's health caps at 1800k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This cap is at 4 charged fragments, each charged fragment allowing you to deal 300k damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-6"><nowiki>Phase 6</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Amascut says Amascut says </nowiki><code><nowiki>I will not be denied!</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and </nowiki><code><nowiki>Mwuahahaha</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and an Engulfing Shadow spawns on Tumeken.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Engulfing Shadow</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This Shadow has 500k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and is attackable. Amascut will start charging a 500k black health bar. The Engulfing Shadow and Amascut's health bar gain 1% LP based on the Engulfed Shadow's remaining lifepoints. Engulfing Shadow Tears will appear, healing the Engulfed Shadow for 1k rapidly and 15k if not absorbed in time. After absorbing tears, a green bar fills up on the player, exploding for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage (~800 per tear?).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Soul Flare</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut will make it rain, with 8 3x3 projectiles landing across the arena. These deal massive typeless damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These can target players current location. For players standing on symbols to pause Collapse: do not stand on the centre tile of the symbols.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Platform Collapse</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ A Collapse countdown of 24s starts, when the timer runs out, the jumper is instakilled.</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1" alt="instakill" title="instakill" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Tumeken names one player (referred to as Jumper), and that player can take the path of Tumeken to a platform on the west or east and kill the Devourer minions, moving to the next platform every time.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The Countdown can get paused temporarily by having another player stand on the same symbol as the jumper is on. This symbol will light up when stood upon. After killing all Devourers, the Jumper takes Tumeken's Light and gets the Enlightened buff </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1" alt="interceptor" title="interceptor" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and a 5x5 light area surrounds them. The Jumper reenters the arena, and the Engulfed Shadow will disappear. Amascut says </nowiki><code><nowiki>I WILL NOT BE SUBJUGATED BY A MORTAL!</nowiki></code><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Note: If the Jumper with Enlightened dies in phase 6, Amascut will start emptying her black health bar immediately! This can easily wipe the party if unprepared.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ Rotation: 20% start → 2 autos → swipes → 1 auto → Player Bomb → 2 autos → swipes → 2 autos → Player Bomb → auto → swipes → 3 same autos → Empowered Eruption → swipes → 3 same autos → swipes → Soul Prison</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Shadows of Amascut</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut says </nowiki><code><nowiki>Fall to the shadow</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and Shadows of Amascut appear that need to be killed, one for each player not tanking Amascut. The Shadows deal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage when dashing towards you, otherwise attack with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> , and have the Shadow Link buff </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1403076345084379337.png?v=1" alt="shadowlink" title="shadowlink" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Can be stunned </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1" alt="stunicon" title="stunicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Green bars fill on the Shadows after the first one dies, and they respawn when full. These bars reset when another Shadow is killed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A common strategy is to death dot, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ) with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="deflectmage" title="deflectmage" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, then swap to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="deflectmelee" title="deflectmelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after the Shadows dive-bomb you. Can use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1" alt="threadsoffate" title="threadsoffate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1" alt="bloat" title="bloat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1" alt="volleyofsouls" title="volleyofsouls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1" alt="deathguard90" title="deathguard90" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or (early) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626509025290.png?v=1" alt="magmatempest" title="magmatempest" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1" alt="deto" title="deto" kind="icon" /><nowiki> into </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153882861568.png?v=1" alt="gchaincaroming" title="gchaincaroming" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to clear.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Player Bomb</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>When Amascut says </nowiki><code><nowiki>Your companions will betray you, as they always do.</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ A green bar starts on one player and gradually appears on all players with a Shadow of Amascut attacking them.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When the green bar on the player is full, you take a 7x7 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1" alt="defence" title="defence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> penetration typeless hit (12k). Standing in the Tumeken's Light 5x5 area of the Jumper greatly reduces this damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Note: Blasts outside the area still hurt those inside!</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When a second bomb happens (same voiceline), </nowiki><ins><nowiki>all</nowiki></ins><nowiki> players will get the green bar at the same time.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Killing all Shadows stuns Amascut for 25s, allowing you to DPS down the black health bar. Only after depleting all the black health can her true health be reduced.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ After the stun all remaining black bar health will be dealt as damage to the team in rapid succession.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut's true health caps at 600k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Soul Prison</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: This mechanic only appears 2min 40s after the </nowiki><code><nowiki>Subjugated by a mortal!</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎voiceline, and is rarely seen.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Amascut will say </nowiki><code><nowiki>You will take their place, and watch as this vision becomes reality</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and one player (without Tumeken's light) will get imprisoned on the glyphs.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This is on the same side as was used prior in phase 6. They will be in a 3x3 of tiles that will explode in 6s. This player has to have their shackles broken by another player, and be pushed towards the one safe tile.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The imprisoned player can get dive-bombed on by their Shadow of Amascut, as will whoever frees them, if those shadows are still alive.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/55scg0L8nD.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-7"><nowiki>Phase 7</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Amascut says </nowiki><code><nowiki>YOU ARE NOTHING</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and teleports everyone to the throne room (27x27 tiles, or 9 &quot;9x9&quot; sections).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Tumeken is directly north, Apmeken's altar northwest, Scabaras' northeast, Crondis' southeast, and Het's southwest. She gains the Inner Darkness buff </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1403076345084379337.png?v=1" alt="shadowlink" title="shadowlink" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, meaning she will take reduced damage from all sources not blessed by the Light Within buff </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1" alt="interceptor" title="interceptor" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>*Notes: Amascut stands one tile north of centre.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Every </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> auto-attack gives every player 1 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402610315480535050.png?v=1" alt="corruption" title="corruption" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stack.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Tumeken has 400k health. When he dies, everyone gets instakilled.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ EZK's Flamebound Rival </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1" alt="ezk" title="ezk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and storm shards </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1" alt="stormshards" title="stormshards" kind="icon" /><nowiki> remain during phase transition to phase 7.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Taking a typeless Hieroglyph or Shockwave hit deals 4k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage to Tumeken per player hit.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You can share the Tumeken Strike damage with players in the same quadrant*</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Rotation:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>Starts at 66% adrenaline → 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> autos → 4.8s charge → Tumeken Strike</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Tumeken Strike</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut will address one of the lesser gods by name and try to strike at Tumeken.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Crondis: </nowiki><code><nowiki>Crondis. It should have never come to this.</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Scabaras: </nowiki><code><nowiki>Scabaras...</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Apmeken: </nowiki><code><nowiki>I am sorry Apmeken.</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Het: </nowiki><code><nowiki>Forgive me, Het.</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Tumeken will aid the called god's altar to bear the brunt of the strike. Provoke </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1" alt="voke" title="voke" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Amascut so she faces towards the called altar. This will let the attack on you ricochet to the altar and send Tumeken's light back at Amascut, stunning her.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><ins><nowiki>When done wrong</nowiki></ins></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Amascut says </nowiki><code><nowiki>Heh Heergh</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎or </nowiki><code><nowiki>Hmmmwuahaha</nowiki></code><nowiki>, Tumeken takes 200k damage, and the party takes massive typeless </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1" alt="defence" title="defence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> penetrating damage. 16 Engulfing Shadow Tears appear, healing Amascut 1k each every tick.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Fail rotation: Tumeken Strike → 3 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> autos → Soul Crush → 3 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> autos → repeat</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><ins><nowiki>When done right</nowiki></ins></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Tumeken takes a small hit (12.5k), Amascut says </nowiki><code><nowiki>This cannot be the end...</nowiki></code><nowiki>, all players get the Light Within buff </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1" alt="interceptor" title="interceptor" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for 30s and Amascut gets stunned for ~7s. After this, Amascut will use Empowered Eruptions alongside Empowered Shockwaves or Empowered Hieroglyphs. After Light Within has expired, Amascut will repeat Tumeken Strike.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ An effect dependent on the god is applied.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Apmeken: A random player gets Apmeken's Burden debuff </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402579857648390224.png?v=1" alt="apmekensburden" title="apmekensburden" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Scabaras: Explosive scarabs spawn. kill, grab and throw multiple to break Amascut's Carapace </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585081624924210.png?v=1" alt="carapace" title="carapace" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Requires 3 scarabs.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Crondis: Two Modest crocodile Demons (with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402583151322071091.png?v=1" alt="modesty" title="modesty" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ) spawn in; one southwest and one northeast.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Het: Amascut gains Healing in Strength </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585055297273896.png?v=1" alt="healinginstrength" title="healinginstrength" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Heals herself for ~30% of damage dealt.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Empowered Shockwaves</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Four versions have been observed:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Inner area is safe (9x9)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Middle ring is safe, 3 tiles wide (5 tiles from Amascut)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Far-middle ring is safe, 3 tiles wide (8 tiles from Amascut)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Outer ring is safe, 3 tiles wide</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Empowered Hieroglyphs (after Apmeken)</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Similar to the Nakatra fight, various 9x9 sections of the arena will glow blue and blow up. She divides the arena in 9 sections, of which 3-8 sections are about to be blasted. Getting hit resets defensive cooldowns.</nowiki></p>
